text.zh-CN: 重症登革热是登革热出现危及生命并发症的阶段，需要医院监护。
text.en: Severe dengue is dengue with life-threatening complications requiring hospital monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 登革病毒由伊蚊传播；发热、头痛和全身疼痛可以是早期表现。不是每个感染者都会发展成重症。
text.en: Aedes mosquitoes transmit dengue virus. Fever, headache and body pain may occur early; not every infection becomes severe.

text.en: Severe disease involves plasma leakage causing shock or respiratory distress, severe bleeding or major organ injury; low platelets alone do not define it.

text.zh-CN: 疑似或确诊登革热时出现持续或严重腹痛、反复呕吐、鼻牙龈出血、嗜睡或异常烦躁，应立即到医院评估。
text.en: With suspected or confirmed dengue, seek immediate hospital assessment for persistent/severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, gum/nose bleeding, drowsiness or unusual restlessness.

text.zh-CN: 呼吸急促、皮肤苍白湿冷、昏倒、意识变化或呕血黑便，立即呼叫当地急救；不要自行驾车，也不要等血检预约。
text.en: Call emergency services for rapid breathing, pale clammy skin, collapse, altered awareness or blood in vomit/black stools. Do not drive yourself or wait for a scheduled blood test.

text.zh-CN: 病毒核酸或 NS1 抗原在早期有用，抗体结果随病程改变；医生按发病时间组合检查。早期阴性不能单独排除，单次抗体阳性也可能受既往感染或交叉反应影响。
text.en: Viral RNA or NS1 tests help early, while antibody results change over time. Timing guides testing; an early negative result alone cannot exclude dengue, and antibodies may reflect prior infection or cross-reaction.

text.en: Clinicians follow circulation, awareness, urine, haematocrit and platelets, adding organ tests when indicated. Suspected severe disease is treated without waiting for virological confirmation.
